held.question_en: Return the revision history (predecessor and successor versions) of TDoc R1-2501234 (revision-lineage tracing).
held.cypher: MATCH (t:Tdoc {tdocNumber: 'R1-2501234'}) OPTIONAL MATCH (t)-[:IS_REVISION_OF]->(prev:Tdoc) OPTIONAL MATCH (t)-[:REVISED_TO]->(next:Tdoc) RETURN prev.tdocNumber AS previous, t.tdocNumber AS current, t.title, next.tdocNumber AS revised_to ORDER BY t.tdocNumber ASC LIMIT 10

held.question_en: Are the Feature-to-entity relations (usesIE, hasCapability, hasProcedure) loaded? (feature-linkage check)
held.cypher: MATCH (f:Feature) OPTIONAL MATCH (f)-[r1:usesIE]->(:RRCParameter) OPTIONAL MATCH (f)-[r2:hasCapability]->(:CapabilityItem) OPTIONAL MATCH (f)-[r3:hasProcedure]->(:Procedure) WITH f, count(DISTINCT r1) AS ie_links, count(DISTINCT r2) AS cap_links, count(DISTINCT r3) AS proc_links RETURN f.featureName AS feature, ie_links, cap_links, proc_links ORDER BY ie_links + cap_links + proc_links DESC LIMIT 22

held.question_en: Are the 28 LTM capability items loaded as :CapabilityItem nodes? (baseline-coverage check)
held.cypher: MATCH (cap:CapabilityItem) WHERE cap.capabilityItemName STARTS WITH 'ltm-' AND cap.granularity = 'item' RETURN count(cap) AS ltm_cap_count, collect(cap.capabilityItemName)[..10] AS sample

held.question_en: Are the Feature relations usesIE, hasCapability, and hasProcedure loaded to RRCParameter, CapabilityItem, and Procedure nodes (feature-linkage check)?
held.cypher: MATCH (f:Feature) OPTIONAL MATCH (f)-[r1:usesIE]->(:RRCParameter) OPTIONAL MATCH (f)-[r2:hasCapability]->(:CapabilityItem) OPTIONAL MATCH (f)-[r3:hasProcedure]->(:Procedure) WITH f, count(DISTINCT r1) AS ie_links, count(DISTINCT r2) AS cap_links, count(DISTINCT r3) AS proc_links RETURN f.featureName AS feature, ie_links, cap_links, proc_links ORDER BY ie_links + cap_links + proc_links DESC LIMIT 22

held.question_en: Which other TRs does TR 38.825 reference (outgoing TR references)?
held.cypher:
MATCH (tr:TechnicalReport {trNumber: '38.825'})-[:REFERENCES_TR]->(ref:TechnicalReport)
                  RETURN ref.trNumber

held.question_en: Which other TRs reference TR 38.825 (incoming TR references)?
held.cypher:
MATCH (ref:TechnicalReport)-[:REFERENCES_TR]->(tr:TechnicalReport {trNumber: '38.825'})
                  RETURN ref.trNumber

held.question_en: Return the most-referenced TRs (central studies).
held.cypher:
MATCH (ref:TechnicalReport)-[:REFERENCES_TR]->(tr:TechnicalReport)
                  RETURN tr.trNumber, count(ref) AS refCount ORDER BY refCount DESC LIMIT 10

held.question_en: Count resolutions per Work Item (Work-Item decision volume).
held.cypher: MATCH (r:Resolution)-[:REFERENCES]->(t:Tdoc)-[:RELATED_TO]->(wi:WorkItem) MATCH (r)-[:MADE_AT]->(m:Meeting) RETURN wi.workItemName AS wi, count(DISTINCT r) AS cnt ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 10

held.question_en: Verify that the Feature-to-entity relations usesIE, hasCapability, and hasProcedure are loaded (feature-linkage check).
held.cypher: MATCH (f:Feature) OPTIONAL MATCH (f)-[r1:usesIE]->(:RRCParameter) OPTIONAL MATCH (f)-[r2:hasCapability]->(:CapabilityItem) OPTIONAL MATCH (f)-[r3:hasProcedure]->(:Procedure) WITH f, count(DISTINCT r1) AS ie_links, count(DISTINCT r2) AS cap_links, count(DISTINCT r3) AS proc_links RETURN f.featureName AS feature, ie_links, cap_links, proc_links ORDER BY ie_links + cap_links + proc_links DESC LIMIT 22

held.question_en: Verify that Feature disjointWith relations (e.g. LTM, CHO, CPC, CPAC) match the feature catalog (disjointness consistency).
held.cypher: MATCH (a:Feature)-[:disjointWith]->(b:Feature) WHERE a.featureId < b.featureId RETURN a.featureId AS a, b.featureId AS b ORDER BY a, b

held.question_en: Verify that the 28 LTM capability items are loaded as CapabilityItem nodes (baseline-parity check).
held.cypher: MATCH (cap:CapabilityItem) WHERE cap.capabilityItemName STARTS WITH 'ltm-' AND cap.granularity = 'item' RETURN count(cap) AS ltm_cap_count, collect(cap.capabilityItemName)[..10] AS sample

held.question_en: Check for outgoing TR-to-TR references (cross-study reference check).
held.cypher: MATCH (tr:TechnicalReport)-[r:REFERENCES_TR]->(other:TechnicalReport) RETURN DISTINCT tr.trNumber AS src, other.trNumber AS tgt ORDER BY src LIMIT 10

held.question_en: Check for incoming TR-to-TR references (reverse cross-study check).
held.cypher: MATCH (tr:TechnicalReport)<-[r:REFERENCES_TR]-(other:TechnicalReport) RETURN DISTINCT tr.trNumber AS target, other.trNumber AS referrer ORDER BY target LIMIT 10

held.question_en: Trace the revision chain of TDoc R4-2417515 (revision-lineage tracing).
held.cypher: MATCH (t:Tdoc {tdocNumber:'R4-2417515'})-[:IS_REVISION_OF*1..3]->(prev:Tdoc) RETURN prev.tdocNumber

held.question_en: List the top 10 work items by number of resolutions (most-decided work items).
held.cypher: MATCH (r:Resolution)-[:REFERENCES]->(t:Tdoc)-[:RELATED_TO]->(wi:WorkItem) MATCH (r)-[:MADE_AT]->(m:Meeting) RETURN wi.workItemName AS wi, count(DISTINCT r) AS cnt ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 10

held.question_en: How many tables does section A.3.2.2.2 of spec 38.101-4 contain? (table density check).
held.cypher: MATCH (sec:Section {sectionId: '38.101-4-A.3.2.2.2'})-[:CONTAINS_TABLE]->(t:TSTable) RETURN count(t) AS tableCount, collect(t.tableNumber)[..10] AS samples

held.question_en: How many Rel-18 CRs on spec 38.133 are linked to a resolution? (decision-coverage check).
held.cypher: MATCH (cr:CR)-[:MODIFIES]->(sp:Spec {specNumber: '38.133'}), (cr)-[:TARGET_RELEASE]->(rel:Release {releaseName: 'Rel-18'}), (r:Resolution)-[:REFERENCES]->(cr) RETURN count(DISTINCT cr) AS crWithResolution, count(DISTINCT r) AS resolutionCount

held.question_en: Are the Feature-to-entity relations usesIE, hasCapability, and hasProcedure loaded? (feature-link verification).
held.cypher: MATCH (f:Feature) OPTIONAL MATCH (f)-[r1:usesIE]->(:RRCParameter) OPTIONAL MATCH (f)-[r2:hasCapability]->(:CapabilityItem) OPTIONAL MATCH (f)-[r3:hasProcedure]->(:Procedure) WITH f, count(DISTINCT r1) AS ie_links, count(DISTINCT r2) AS cap_links, count(DISTINCT r3) AS proc_links RETURN f.featureName AS feature, ie_links, cap_links, proc_links ORDER BY ie_links + cap_links + proc_links DESC LIMIT 22

held.question_en: Do the disjointWith relations between Features (e.g. LTM, CHO, CPC, CPAC) match the feature-catalog disjoint groups? (consistency check).
held.cypher: MATCH (a:Feature)-[:disjointWith]->(b:Feature) WHERE a.featureId < b.featureId RETURN a.featureId AS a, b.featureId AS b ORDER BY a, b

held.question_en: Are the 28 LTM capability items loaded as CapabilityItem nodes? (capability baseline check).
held.cypher: MATCH (cap:CapabilityItem) WHERE cap.capabilityItemName STARTS WITH 'ltm-' AND cap.granularity = 'item' RETURN count(cap) AS ltm_cap_count, collect(cap.capabilityItemName)[..10] AS sample

held.question_en: List the other TRs that TR 38.803 references (outbound TR citations).
held.cypher: MATCH (tr:TechnicalReport {trNumber: '38.803'})-[:REFERENCES_TR]->(ref:TechnicalReport) RETURN ref.trNumber, ref.trTitle ORDER BY ref.trNumber

held.question_en: Find resolutions marking a document for comeback (deferred-item tracking).
held.cypher: MATCH (r:Resolution) WHERE r.content CONTAINS 'comeback' OR r.content CONTAINS 'Comeback' OR r.content CONTAINS 'come back' RETURN r.resolutionId AS id, substring(r.content, 0, 100) AS content_preview LIMIT 10

held.question_en: List the section references from TS 38.521-1 to TS 38.533 (directed cross-spec links).
held.cypher: MATCH (a:Section)-[:BELONGS_TO_SPEC]->(sa:Spec {specNumber: '38.521-1'}), (a)-[:REFERENCES_SECTION]->(b:Section)-[:BELONGS_TO_SPEC]->(sb:Spec {specNumber: '38.533'}) RETURN a.sectionId AS src, b.sectionId AS tgt LIMIT 10

held.question_en: Which RAN5 specs do CRs modify, grouped by Work Item? (work-item spec impact)
held.cypher: MATCH (cr:CR)-[:RELATED_TO]->(wi:WorkItem), (cr)-[:MODIFIES]->(sp:Spec) WHERE sp.specNumber STARTS WITH '38.5' RETURN wi.workItemId, sp.specNumber, count(cr) AS crCount ORDER BY crCount DESC LIMIT 10

held.cypher: MATCH (f:Feature) OPTIONAL MATCH (f)-[r1:usesIE]->(:RRCParameter) OPTIONAL MATCH (f)-[r2:hasCapability]->(:CapabilityItem) OPTIONAL MATCH (f)-[r3:hasProcedure]->(:Procedure) WITH f, count(DISTINCT r1) AS ie_links, count(DISTINCT r2) AS cap_links, count(DISTINCT r3) AS proc_links RETURN f.featureName AS feature, ie_links, cap_links, proc_links ORDER BY ie_links + cap_links + proc_links DESC LIMIT 22

held.question_en: Which other TRs does TR 38.903 reference? (outgoing TR citations)
held.cypher: MATCH (tr:TechnicalReport {trNumber: '38.903'})-[:REFERENCES_TR]->(ref:TechnicalReport) RETURN ref.trNumber, ref.trTitle ORDER BY ref.trNumber

held.question_en: Which TRs reference TR 38.905? (incoming TR citations)

held.question_en: Which TRs are cited most by other TRs? (most-referenced ranking)
held.cypher: MATCH (src:TechnicalReport)-[:REFERENCES_TR]->(tr:TechnicalReport) RETURN tr.trNumber, count(src) AS refCount ORDER BY refCount DESC LIMIT 10
